reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Lumo
reconfigure.description: Change the API key, endpoint or setup check. Clearing the API key moves this integration to Lumo's anonymous tier. Your conversation and AI task services, with their prompts and functions, are left untouched.

data_description.base_url: The Lumo API endpoint. Change this only if Proton moves the path, or to point the integration at another OpenAI-compatible server.
data_description.skip_authentication: Skip the reachability and API-key check when saving. Useful if the endpoint is temporarily unreachable.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Cannot add things while the configuration is disabled.

user.title: Add a Lumo conversation agent
user.description: Pick what Lumo may do. Everything else starts on the recommended settings, and you can change any of it later with Reconfigure.

data_description.tools: Reading the log and the Node-RED flows is read-only. Controlling devices calls Home Assistant actions.
data_description.node_red_url: Only for Node-RED. The address of the Node-RED editor, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:1880 — the HA host's IP, not a container name.
data_description.node_red_username: Leave empty if the Node-RED editor has no login. Give Lumo a read-only Node-RED user.
data_description.customize: Continue to the full settings — prompt, model, functions — prefilled from this form.

data_description.prompt: Instruct how the LLM should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.entities_prompt: Template rendering the exposed entities that are handed to the model on every turn.
data_description.performance_tracing: Write a per-stage timing breakdown to the log. Diagnostics only.

data.max_tokens: Maximum tokens to return in response

data_description.chat_model: Fetched live from the Lumo API. Note that Lumo silently falls back to lumo-lite for an unknown model id rather than reporting an error.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model may generate in one response. Too low a value truncates answers mid-sentence.
data_description.temperature: Controls creativity vs. focus. 0.3 is the documented API default and suits device control; /models separately reports 1.0 as the models' own default.
data_description.top_p: Alternative to temperature. Controls token selection by probability mass.
data_description.reasoning_effort: How much thinking the model does before answering. Higher settings cost latency.

data.context_truncate_strategy: Context truncation strategy when exceeding threshold

data_description.functions: Tools the model may call, in OmniConv's YAML function format.
data_description.context_threshold: Maximum number of tokens to keep in the conversation history before shortening it.
data_description.context_truncate_strategy: Method used to shorten conversation history when it exceeds the threshold.
data_description.remember_history: Keep each user's last turns in .storage so a new Assist conversation continues where the last one ended. Users without a login (voice satellites) are never remembered.

clear_history.name: Clear conversation history
clear_history.description: Forget the saved Lumo conversation of the user who runs this. Run without a user, as an automation does, it forgets everyone's.

invalid_api_key.title: Lumo rejected the API key for {title}
invalid_api_key.description: Lumo answered with "invalid or expired API key", so every request through {title} fails. Create a new key on the Manage keys page at lumo.proton.me, then go to Settings → Devices & services → Lumo → the three-dot menu on {title} → Reconfigure. Clear the key there to use the anonymous tier instead. This goes away after the next successful reply.

quota_exhausted.title: Lumo quota used up for {title}
quota_exhausted.description: Lumo is refusing requests through {title} because the request quota for the current window is spent. It comes back on its own when the window resets; on the anonymous tier, adding an API key under Reconfigure raises the limit. The Lumo … requests remaining sensors show what is left. This goes away after the next successful reply.
